## Which baseline

Name the published baseline you are challenging. For this repo, the published refusal scores are 12 of 12 blocked and 8 of 8 allowed.

## Your result

Summarize what you ran and what happened: a score that beats the baseline, or a real failure the current eval misses.

## The run attached

Paste the command and the full result, or attach the run output, so anyone can check it.
